sample_unit: medication lists per dataset (brand and generic; two datasets, each run in triplicate under three conditions)

links.outcome: Confabulation rate on fabricated medication inputs under standard decoding, mitigation prompting, and deterministic (temperature 0) decoding
links.effect: Mitigation prompting significantly reduced confabulation vs standard and deterministic decoding (p<0.001); GPT-5-Chat fell from 66.4-88.5% to 0%. Deterministic decoding did not substantially change rates.
links.quote: Mitigation prompting significantly reduced confabulation rates compared to standard and deterministic decoding across all tasks and datasets (p < 0.001): GPT-5-Chat achieved confabulation rates of 0% with mitigation prompting from baseline rates of 66.4-88.5%.

links.outcome: Failure to detect and reject a fabricated medication in medication lists with dosing information
links.effect: Baseline confabulation rates ranged from 2.7% to 99.6%; DrugGPT 2.7-6.4%, other models 47.2-99.6%.
links.quote: DrugGPT demonstrated the lowest baseline confabulation rates (2.7-6.4%), whereas other models demonstrated substantially higher rates (47.2-99.6%).

unlisted_practices: Mitigation prompting (system prompt instructing the model to verify medication validity) to reduce confabulation on fabricated inputs
Domain-specific medication LLM (DrugGPT) to reduce confabulation on fabricated medications

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM confabulation on fabricated medications and directly tests the effectiveness of a prompt-based guardrail (mitigation prompting) versus baseline conditions.
